description: Assertion helpers for Result, Result<T>, the typed Result<T, E1..E3>, Maybe<T> and problem details HTTP responses. They throw ResultAssertionException with every error in the message, so they work from any test framework.

Contract scenarios for IResourceLock implementations of CSharpEssentials.Mediator that run from any test framework, and RecordingResourceLock, a public in-process fake that records every acquire and release for LockBehavior tests.
Hosted service for the CSharpEssentials.EntityFrameworkCore outbox: drains IOutboxProcessor in a background loop, polling when the outbox is empty. Register it with AddOutboxProcessorHostedService.
Readiness health check for EF Core: reports Unhealthy while a DbContext has pending migrations or the database cannot be reached. Register it with AddMigrationsCheck, tagged "ready" by default.

Distributed IResourceLock for CSharpEssentials.Mediator over an EF Core relational connection: runs dialect SQL such as PostgreSQL pg_try_advisory_lock or SQL Server sp_getapplock, with no provider package dependency.
